reason: The slip reading would fix the typing I hate, but a Shortcut on my iPhone with a video to set up feels like a chore I'd have to do before I even see any benefit. I already quit a budget app over manual entry, so I'm wary of starting something that asks more of me up front.
objection: If the setup is fiddly and breaks when the bank changes its slip layout, I'll be back to typing everything by hand within a month.
would_change_my_mind: A setup that takes a couple of minutes with no video, and proof it keeps working on my K PLUS slips after a few weeks.
